title: The Hiring
description: Can a 258 lb dad run a sub-3 marathon? I hired five AI coaches to find out, and they argue over every run. This is the morning they got hired.
writeup: In October, the first time I asked my Garmin about a marathon, it said 4:39:49. Chicago is October 10, 2027, and I need 2:59:59.

Every run I finish reaches the coaches within minutes. By the time I'm out of the shower they've argued about it, and tomorrow's run is already on my wrist, with a heart-rate range on the easy days and a pace range on the hard ones. Rook, the head coach, settles it.

Kai, the running coach, has a first rule: my easy days go slower than I want. Episode 2, December 6, is the hill where I broke it. The Chicago drawing answers December 8, and the first 5K is December 26.
All five coaches are animated AI characters with AI voices. My own training, shared as it happens. Not medical advice.
garmin: the first marathon prediction was 4:39:49 on October 19. On November 21 it read 4:36:10.
